1.1.0.en: Added support for light and dimmer modules.

1.1.1.en: Updated the app id for publishing.

1.3.0.en: Added comfort sensors and alloff routine.

1.3.4.en: Fixed an application crash that can happen when a device is deleted.

1.4.0.en: Added support for the Niko Fan module.

1.5.0.en: Added all comfort sensor button variants.

1.5.2.en: Fixed a few crashes and added capability to Connected Controller.

1.6.1.en: Improved the images for the All-off routine.

1.6.2.en: Fix a few crashes due to devices no longe being available.

1.7.0.en: Added ability to set motor position to specific percentage instead of only open/close.

1.8.0.en: Added a diagnostic report to the advanced settings menu of the Connected Controller.

1.8.1.en: Fixed an issue where settings could no longer be updated on the Connected Controller.

1.9.1.en: Fixed a connection issue when updating the settings of the connected controller.

1.9.2.en: Fixed an issue where devices incorrectly showed as misconfigured and could not be controlled.

1.10.0.en: Added ability to change what is plugged into the relay module.

1.10.1.en: Fixed an issue where the device class of lights & sockets was not set correctly.

1.11.0.en: Added token expiry reminders and Flow cards, plus French, Danish and Swedish translations. Improved connection stability.

1.12.0.en: Added Thermostat, Virtual flag and Home energy devices, an easier controller setup with a connection test, and a Repair option to renew the token.

1.13.0.en: Added Socket, Switched fan, Switched output and Smart plug devices. Existing devices keep working.

1.13.1.en: New Niko-style device images and icons, and clearer device names.

1.14.0.en: Added routines for custom routines, house status, presence alert, warning mode, presence simulation, solar mode and peak mode, with matching Niko-style images.

1.14.1.en: Home energy now shows kWh from and to the grid.
